{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Pulse Wave Analyser''' is a mining scanner used to highlight asteroids that may be worth inspecting for core or deposit mining. It helps narrow the search, but a commander still has to inspect and prospect candidates before committing to extraction.

{{Draft warning}}

== Mining role ==

{{#invoke:Mining|equipmentNote|page=Pulse Wave Analyser}}

The analyser is most closely associated with [[Core Mining]], where commanders search for candidate core asteroids before confirming them with closer inspection and prospecting. It can also help with deposit-focused searches, but it does not replace a [[Prospector Limpet Controller]] or guarantee that the highlighted asteroid contains the desired commodity.
